description: Servizi web del trasporto pubblico locale in Alto Adige is a dataset listed in Italian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Provincia autonoma di Bolzano. Il presente webservice è stato sviluppato nell’ambito del progetto EFRE 2017/2013 dell’Unione Europea con lo scopo di mettere a disposizione i dati pubblici del traffico locale a sviluppatori ed aziende che sono attivi nel settore della mobilità in Alto Adige ed in Europa. Coverage: Provincia autonoma di Bolzano. The portal files it under the publisher Provincia autonoma di Bolzano. Its tags are bus, mobilita, orari, reti-di-trasporto, trasporti. It offers 3 resource(s) in HTML, PDF, XML. The portal shows 2026-09-05 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-it-portal.
